title: Portfolio exclusion list
description: Site-exclusion list for manifest slugs. Repository folder names excluded from the directory scan have moved to drift.config.ts → excludedRepoNames (paired to scanRoot). Written by `drift hide <slug>` for the slugs array.

slugs.description: Project slugs (matching sources.json keys) excluded from the public site. A slug here is absent from the projects array, all filter views, the map, the timeline, the sitemap, and OG prerender.
